mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 5-day SPX returns is positive in more than 60% of 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both falling in the same month) does not lead to negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 305.0), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 305.0, the 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO predicting 20-day SPX returns is positive in more than 60% of 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500.0 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence and lower economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1500.0, the 5-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE does not lead to negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annually), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals over-optimism in consumer spending that leads to a correction in equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and RSAFS declining, the 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
